description:
Friendship management tool for VRChat


This released is a bit rushed due to VRC breaking things.
Additions
- New settings to enable profile cosmetics in Settings -> Interface -> User Dialog.
- By default VRCX will use custom profile theme colours, an option has been added to disable this behavior in Settings -> Interface -> VRChat Profile Themes.
- Cosmetics can be individually enabled per section (sidebar/friend locations).
- Edit profile dialog.
  - Edit and create profile themes.
  - Change banner image/colour.
  - Change profile icon.
  - Change profile background.
  - Change nameplate effect
  - Change profile effect.
  - Change icon frame.
- Add favorite functionality for prints. #1858
- Add local favourites to quick search.
- Add join count to group dialog.
- Create/edit group events.
- Create/edit/transfer groups.
- Bulk delete moderations.
- Added inventory filter.
- Notification filter for Group Event Created/Starting.
- Group instance announcement, only works while you're in the instance.

Changes
- Massive dialog redesign, based upon design from shinyflvre's PR.
- Group moderation managerNotes full note on hover.

Fixes
- Fix local friend favorite group filter.
- Preserve group order during reordering. #1839
- Fix gamelog table delete button.
- Fix edit note memo button in dropdown. #1842
- Keep the Friends sidebar collapsed after leaving Friends Locations. #1856
- Fix friend search.
- Fix database migration error.

Linux/macOS
- Update to dotnet 10. #1771
- Enable "Open in Game" on Linux. #1837
- Fixed an issue with a deadlock hanging electron, which kept the tray icon around. #1843
